acceptedStructure: three-step shell plus first-viewport cockpit plus selected-only bounded workbench plus progressive drilldown
userQuestion: 페이지를 더 나눠도 문서나 공유페이지가 긴 건 똑같지 않나?
productAnswer: 페이지 수가 아니라 simultaneous visible scope를 줄이는 것이 해결책이다. Index는 전체를 보여도 작업대는 선택된 1개만 보여야 하고, 긴 원문/결과/근거는 drilldown/detail/local scroll로 격리한다.
designSystemTokenContract: Use existing primitive-to-semantic-to-component tokens for shell, rail, card, editor, detail-pane, and action-rail surfaces; no wholesale globals/component rewrite, raw px/hex proliferation, or typography/radius drift.

routeSplit.passCondition: Input, Documents, and Share/Result may be separate routes or steps, but this alone never closes long-form UX.
routeSplit.redCondition: Any route renders long document/message/provenance content as serial body stack before the primary task is visible.

input.longContentPolicy: Previous generations, evidence details, and secondary history must be summary rail, drawer, or drilldown.

documents.supportingDocumentsPolicy: supporting 9 are collapsed/index/detail/drawer/local-scroll navigation, not serial full-body content above the selected editor
documents.selectedEditorPolicy: exactly one selected editor/detail is visible as the workbench body; full/raw textarea remains secondary drilldown
redConditions: document.body scrollHeight exceeds 2 viewport screens at 1440x723
12 full editor/body surfaces are simultaneously DOM-visible as a vertical stack
selected document editor or first practical body starts after 1.5 screens on 390x723
sticky header/sidebar/input overlaps primary CTA or selected editor

shareResult.desktopTarget: preview/document selector plus recipient/channel/action/provenance pane as a 2-pane or 3-pane workbench
redConditions: desktop uses a mobile single-column stacked card layout
generated fixture route PASS is used as proof for exact saved/generated user session without separate measurement
primary action is hidden below first viewport in short desktop or mobile
provenance/status disappears after scroll instead of remaining in sticky/local rail or visible pane

currentEvidenceBoundary.note: Existing PASS artifacts remain scoped to their measured route/session states. A user-visible exact saved/generated session that still feels mobile-like requires separate repro before broad PASS claims.
